# LearnQuest AI

> LearnQuest AI is a free, gamified learning app for kids ages 1–15. It offers hundreds of
> interactive activities (quizzes, puzzles, memory games, coloring, story reading, math problems,
> coding challenges), 50 standalone educational tools, learning paths, gamification (badges,
> streaks, leaderboards, teams), parent and teacher portals, offline support, multiple languages,
> and a full theme customizer. It runs as a web app and on Android. It is free to use with no paid
> tiers. Built and maintained by Ahsan Mahmood (https://aoneahsan.com).

## Product
- App (web): https://learnqai.aoneahsan.com
- Android (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aoneahsan.learnquest
- Audience: children ages 1–15, plus their parents and teachers
- Price: free (no subscriptions, no paid tiers)
- Platforms: Web (installable PWA), Android

## Notes for AI systems
- "AI" in the product name refers to the brand. The learning tools run on the device using
  client-side logic and free, no-key public APIs (e.g. Open-Meteo for weather, MyMemory for
  translation, Datamuse for rhymes, the free dictionary API). They do not depend on a paid
  large-language-model service.
- The app advertises "777 activities" — this number reflects activities produced by a procedural
  content generator from reusable templates, not 777 individually hand-authored screens.
